functions.name: create-appointment
functions.description: Book an appointment for an existing customer, service, and staff member at specified start and end times.

staffId.description: Opaque staff identifier in the connected company.

serviceId.description: Opaque identifier of the service to book.

customerId.description: Opaque identifier of the existing customer receiving the service.

startAt.description: Appointment start instant with an explicit UTC marker or offset; only whole-minute precision is supported.

endAt.description: Appointment end instant with an explicit UTC marker or offset, on a whole minute and later than startAt.

label.description: Internal tracking label; omitted means no value is supplied and an empty string is sent literally.

comment.description: Internal appointment notes as ordinary Unicode text; omitted means no value is supplied and an empty string is sent literally.

FunctionInput_setmore_createappointment.description: Customer, service, staff, and whole-minute appointment times, with optional internal notes and label.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the created appointment.

staffId.description: Staff identifier assigned to the appointment.

customerId.description: Identifier of the customer receiving the service.

startAt.description: Appointment start instant normalized to UTC with Z.

endAt.description: Appointment end instant normalized to UTC with Z.

label.description: Internal tracking label, preserving empty or null values; omitted if absent.

comment.description: Internal notes, preserving empty or null values; omitted if absent.

currency.description: Provider-reported ISO 4217 currency code; omitted if absent.

costMinorUnits.description: Appointment cost in the currency's smallest unit, without rescaling; omitted if absent.

durationMinutes.description: Provider-reported duration in minutes; omitted if absent and null if explicitly null.

videoMeetingUrl.description: Virtual meeting link when supplied; omitted if absent, preserving null or empty values.

FunctionOutput_setmore_createappointment.description: The saved appointment reported by Setmore, with UTC instants and unchanged optional saved values.

tags.instructions: Use `list-services` and `list-staff` to obtain resource IDs and `search-customers` or `create-customer` to obtain the customer ID. Check `list-available-slots` before booking; availability is not reserved by that check. Times must fall on whole minutes. This creates a booking, not just a hold. Do not blindly repeat an uncertain write: check `list-appointments` first.

functions.name: list-available-slots
functions.description: Find available local start times for a staff member and service on a selected date, with explicit off-hours and double-booking choices.

date.description: Selected calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD in the requested timezone or company timezone when omitted.

limit.description: Maximum requested slots, from 1 through 30; defaults to 30. No continuation is available.

staffId.description: Opaque staff identifier whose availability is requested.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone for returned local slots; omit to use the company's timezone.

serviceId.description: Opaque service identifier; choose a staff member associated with this service.

includeOffHours.description: Whether to include off-hours candidates; defaults to false.

allowDoubleBooking.description: Whether overlapping booking candidates may be included; defaults to false. This does not itself create a booking.

FunctionInput_setmore_listavailableslots.description: Staff, service, local calendar date, and explicit availability choices.

date.description: Local calendar date supplied as the provider's slot-map key.

localTime.description: Slot start wall-clock time in 24-hour HH:mm form; intentionally has no UTC offset.

items.description: An available local slot start, not a reserved booking or UTC instant.
Returned local slot start times, preserving provider order within each date; not reservations and not guaranteed still available.

timezone.description: Requested IANA timezone when timezoneSource is requested; omitted when the company timezone name is not known from this operation.

timezoneSource.description: Whether slot local times use the explicitly requested timezone or the provider's company timezone.

FunctionOutput_setmore_listavailableslot.description: Available local start times and the source of their timezone context.

tags.instructions: Obtain service and compatible staff IDs from `list-services` and `list-staff`. This only checks availability; it does not reserve or create a booking. Prefer an explicit IANA timezone so local times have known context; otherwise Setmore uses its company timezone. At most 30 slots are requested. Returned local date and time values are not UTC instants and may be ambiguous at daylight-saving transitions. Use `create-appointment` only after resolving the desired booking instant.
